session_environment.device_detail: User-directed continuation from iPhone with GitHub-connected implementation

objective.session_objective: Create the authoritative Current Checkpoint, mobile and platform session checklists, and offline conflict and recovery procedure for Prompt #11.
in_scope: iPhone, iPad, ASUS laptop and Zo checklists
ChatGPT, Gemini/NotebookLM, Claude/Hermes, GitHub and Slack checklists
offline, synchronization, conflict, backup and recovery procedures
open GitHub work packets for device safety, the $7 ledger and the first OMNI pilot
out_of_scope: recording passwords, private keys or recovery codes
deploying Zo services or external automations
creating private NotebookLM or Claude workspaces
publishing or minting a commercial product
passing HumanApprovalGate on behalf of the human owner
acceptance_criteria: One file identifies the current project state and exact next action
The packet can be used from a new authorized session without hidden chat context
Device and platform checklists preserve privacy, security and model-line identity
Offline and conflicting work can be reconciled without silent overwrite
The packet clearly distinguishes review-ready from human-approved state

decisions.decision: The Current Checkpoint may point to a review-ready packet but must visibly state when HumanApprovalGate is pending.
decisions.rationale: The project needs a usable resume point without misrepresenting an AI-created or unreviewed record as human-approved.

decisions.decision: GitHub issues #8 through #12 are the current executable work definitions.
decisions.rationale: Issues preserve acceptance criteria, dependencies and durable work references across devices and sessions.

decisions.decision: Slack notifications must link to canonical records and cannot independently pass HumanApprovalGate.
decisions.rationale: Collaboration messages are useful but may be incomplete, informal or separated from the approved artifact and scope.
